svg.aria-label: One prefill on 8 GPUs, token chunks by heads, shaded by owning GPU. TP8: each GPU owns 8 heads of every token and computes the full indexer, so sparse MLA does 26 FLOPs per byte moved and is memory-bound on H200. PCP8: each GPU owns token chunks r and 15 minus r with all 64 heads and indexes only those tokens, so sparse MLA does 191 FLOPs per byte moved, near the H200 ridge of 206
